<security_assessment>

<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a standard Arch Linux package for `shipwright-bin`, an unofficial PC port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. It retrieves a prebuilt AppImage from the project's official GitHub releases page, along with a desktop entry and icon. The source URLs point directly to trusted domains (github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com), under the official project repository (HarbourMasters/Shipwright). The checksums for all sources are explicitly provided and match standard practices for verifying integrity.

The package function installs the AppImage to `/opt/soh/`, places a desktop file and icon in their standard directories, and creates a simple wrapper script in `/usr/bin/soh` to allow launching the application from the command line. All operations are confined to the package directory (`$pkgdir`) and follow typical packaging conventions. There are no network operations, dynamic downloads, or execution of fetched code during installation or runtime setup.

No obfuscated commands, dangerous invocations (e.g., eval, base64 decoding), or unauthorized file accesses are present. The use of `noextract` for the AppImage is appropriate, as AppImages are self-contained binaries. The package does not modify system files outside its scope or inject code into unrelated processes. All dependencies and optional dependencies are relevant to the application's functionality.
</details>
<evidence>

</evidence>
<summary>
Standard packaging; no malicious behavior detected</summary>
</security_assessment>
